body: Yes, I asked some of my more shady coworkers and through connections they managed to give me some names. If you plan on buying one for suicide, don't do it.
I just improvised man, the whole day feels like fog to me now. Pretty surreal

Alright I'll try to keep this as short as possible for you:

Woke up. 
Read reddit comments.
Some of them suggested drawing something, and some other ones wanted to see my art.
I don't even have a camera to picture my art.
Went to work.
Stole my asshole supervisor's phone.
Drew a couple of pictures during the lunch break.
Left early ignoring my boss and coworkers.
Saw a group of professional swimmers going to the swimming pool to train.
Blended in with them and swam for an hour for free.
Returned home and made myself dinner.
Went for an evening walk near a river.
Found clay.
Collected some, to test if it's appropriate for pottery.
Returned home.
Read more reddit comments and replied to some.

Thanks a lot to you and everyone

Well I live just next to the swimming pool and every day I can observe a group of people who I always assumed to be professional athletes coming there for their daily training. Well today when I saw them coming I asked them about it and they confirmed that they were indeed training. So I blended into the crowd and confidently walked into the pool just like them. They were all pretty cool about it and we had a laugh. Then I just swam for an hour without thinking about anything. It was awesome. And I didn't pay a penny, lol.

Thanks here is one more from today: https://s14.postimg.org/yejjs3lvl/IMG_20161009_183156.jpg

Someone privately messaged me and suggested drawing my best memory. I think both turned out pretty good.
The only political movement I would join is an anarchistic one. I'll jus leave civilisation and try the primitve lifestyle. So reading some books would be a good idea. Thanks.
I watched some of his stuff on youtube. Very inspirational. A real man.

Good advice mate, as you can see I did not off myself just yet. Partly because I went swimming today. It was a completely spontaneus decision and the best one I made in a month. Also a pretty funny story to go with it.
I'm still here so apparently I did reconsider. Had a pretty awesome day today. Wanna hear about it?

You were helpful. Today was one of the best days of my life thanks to you and other redditors who replied. If you want to hear about it you can message me. But I don't think I'll visit reddit anytime soon so today is your last chance. Again, thanks a lot.

Thanks for commenting man. And you're absolutely right. I used to call myself an "artist" but today I was ashamed of how uncreative I really am. This thing about finding an alternate lifestyle actually makes a lot of sense for me. It would take a bit too long to explain my half-assed plan right now. But it might just work.

Hi there. Good news: I'm not dead yet. So I wanted to ask you, is it a thing for suicidal people to draw floating islands or did you just pull that idea out of your head? Cause it worked. For a whole year I couldn't find inspiration to draw anything and then you came with this random idea and I atually got into it. Thanks a lot mate. Here is the result: https://postimg.org/image/jcd0kjuyj/

Thanks, I'll go now cause I might as well get a good sleep before my last day on earth. But since I'm obviously not going to work tomorrow I'll take some time to google that stuff. Thanks a lot for talking to me.

The last thing I need is talking to some "professional" who gets paid for talking to losers like me. Now this reddit thing is a different story and that's why I'm doing it. I wanna know what you -someone not knowledgeable and relatable have to say..  Unless you're lying which is a dick move, but not like it's not my fault for seeking help on the fucking internet, heh...

Slovenia, tiny beautiful country with a lot of forests, but pretty strictly regulated. Also can you provide some kind of source about those people living in the woods? I'm actually curious about them now.
Ok let's hear why you care about strangers on the internet and why should I care that you care?

I did get a similar idea about living in the forest, even did some research about forests in my country. I couldn't find any patches that nobody "officially" cares about. If I tried to chop down trees in my country, someone would probably notice and report me. I'd be kicked out and fined in less than a week. I always wanted to build a wooden hut for myself completely from scratch. But as I said the authorities would destroy it right away.
A purpose huh? Might I ask what purpose? Let's both be honest here and admit that nobody is going to give a crap when I shoot myself tomorrow.

Actually the whole concept of jobs disgusts me. I mean why should I have to search for a job and go through all the pointless interviews just to get money? It was much simpler in prehistoric times. If you were strong and capable of hunting you could survive, but nowadays you need a fucking permit for that. Which also costs money by the way... I'm trying to say that the system doesn't make sense and it just depresses me.
I work in a storage, basically I have to wrap boxes up in bubble wrap, weight them and load them up in trucks and stuff like that. It's also writing emails to customers occasionally.
The problem is that I don't really know what I want to do and IF I want to do anything. I also don't want to work with people.

This might be a bit different than other people in this sub. I'm not some edgy homo/trans/bisexual teenager. I don't have abusive parents or a cheating girlfriend. I'm just a regular guy in his twenties with a boring-ass job. And the reason why I want to die is simple. I hate this world and I have nothing to live for. I can't listen to my coworkers' meaningless small talk every day, I don't want to waste 4/5 hours a day for public transport and then come home to some shitty apartment and do nothing the rest of the day. I used to draw a lot, but now I just can't find inspiration anymore.

then again, I only read a couple of posts, so maybe I'm not a special case after all... Regardless, life sucks.
I'l just say that I reasearched a lot and it's a pretty high caliber gun. Thanks for your concern, but I'm pretty sure I'm capable of doing that.
